how_it_works_subtitle: From soil data to crop recommendations in four easy steps
step1_desc: Input your soil's NPK values (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium), pH level, and other parameters like temperature, humidity, and rainfall for your region.
step2_desc: Our powerful Random Forest machine learning model analyzes your soil conditions and compares them with our database of 70+ crops to find the best matches.
step3_desc: Receive your top 3 crop recommendations complete with confidence scores, fertilizer advice, market prices, and seasonal guidance.
step4_desc: Use our insights to plan your planting schedule, optimize fertilizer usage, and maximize your harvest profits with real-time market data.
feature1_desc: Our Random Forest model delivers highly accurate crop recommendations based on extensive agricultural data.
feature2_desc: Comprehensive database covering all major Indian crops including rice, wheat, maize, cotton, sugarcane, coffee, tea, and more.
feature3_desc: Get real-time market prices in ₹/quintal to make informed decisions about which crop to plant for maximum profit.
feature4_desc: Ask our AI farming assistant questions about crops, soil, fertilizers, and market prices using voice input.
feature5_desc: Detailed analysis of your soil's Nitrogen, Phosphorus, and Potassium levels with personalized fertilizer recommendations.
feature6_desc: Completely free for all Indian farmers. No hidden costs, no subscriptions, just honest farming advice.

testimonials_subtitle: Real stories from real farmers who transformed their farming with CropSense
testimonial1_text: CropSense recommended Mustard for my Loamy soil. My yield this Rabi season was the best in 5 years. The market price data alone is worth it.
testimonial2_text: The NPK analysis helped me understand why my Cotton wasn't growing. After the fertilizer advice, my Black soil farm is thriving now.
testimonial3_text: I checked market prices for Coffee before planting. CropSense confirmed ₹42,000/quintal for my Laterite soil. Best decision I ever made.
testimonial4_text: As a small farmer, I never had access to soil testing. CropSense changed everything. Now I know exactly what to plant.
testimonial5_text: The voice assistant is a game changer! I can just ask about crops in my language and get instant answers.
testimonial6_text: I increased my income by 35% after following CropSense recommendations. Best farming decision ever.
